text: The meeting confirmed action owners and ongoing design work, with an Industrial Designer tasked to produce a working design (0) and to advance the conceptual design (3).
The scope includes defining technical functions by the UI Designer (1) and gathering user requirements by the Marketing Expert (2).

Several issues were raised: a missing screen requiring repair or replacement (4), language and preparation delays by the ID participant (5), and equipment/tool reliability concerns noted by the PM (6).

Key decisions set the development path for a new remote control, pricing, revenue targets, and cost constraints, while delineating phase one as functional design and a TV/video baseline with future features (7-12).
